answer_1.quote: Cutting-edge Large Language Models (LLMs) based on the transformer architecture have revolutionized Natural Language Processing with their exceptional performance, notably exemplified by the GPT series in text generation.
answer_1.outputs: The models generate text autoregressively, and the paper evaluates divergence in token generation between original and compressed models.

answer_2.quote: We introduce the family of Divergent Token Metrics (DTMs) in Sec. 3. These metrics are tailored to measure the model divergence of LLMs throughout the compression process and in relation to the actual generation procedure on a token basis...
